notes: Aggressive folk-prophecy voice for X post hooks. Patterns and outcomes combine at post time for combinatorial variety. Keep outcome phrases free of named specifics (no '로또 1등', no '3일 내 5억') and free of fabricated stats/testimonials — this stays inside Google AdSense's get-rich-quick/misrepresentation guardrails.
